test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the one that correctly represents the sentence in direct speech.

Adit explained that he hadn't had the time to prepare his speech the day before.

options.text: Adit said, "I haven't had the time to prepare my speech the day before."
Adit said, "I didn't have the time to prepare my speech yesterday."
Adit said, "I didn't have the time to prepare my speech the day before."
Adit said, "I hadn't had the time to prepare my speech yesterday."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Adit explained that he hadn't had the time to prepare his speech the day before.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"he hadn't had" becomes "I didn't have"**
 
 
• The Past Perfect tense (hadn't had) in indirect speech typically reverts to the Simple Past (didn't have) in direct speech.
